notes: Art briefs per manifest file for tools/ai_art/scenario_gen.py, keyed by the path under Assets/Art/Paradise.
subject: replaces the manifest's purpose in the prompt; say how the engine uses the piece (what repeats, what attaches where).
extra: appended after the subject. mode: repaint (the default for kit pieces), texture (seamless surfaces) or free.
cropRaw: [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the repainted piece to keep before fitting it to the manifest size.
stackPick: which stacked copy of a thin strip to keep (0 = top). remover: another background remover model for this piece.
remover "greykey": cut out the layout's flat grey locally instead (for pale bands a remover deletes).

panels / panelSubjects: how many 21:9 panels a wide backdrop is stitched from, and what each panel holds. trimTop: drop empty sky above a band. derive: make a piece from another generated one (`derive` command).
stitch "blend": cross-fade a wide cut-out backdrop's panels instead of cutting at an empty column (for clouds).
solidBelow: make each panel of a band solid from its top edge down before stitching.

Kit/Architecture/arch_span.png.subject: A round marble arch spanning between two column tops: wedge-shaped voussoir stones around the opening, a carved gold keystone at the crown, a flat entablature above with a thin grass and flower lip on top. The two springing points sit exactly on the bottom edge at the left and right column positions shown; the opening under the arch is empty.

Kit/Architecture/arch_span_wide.png.subject: A wide round marble arch spanning between two column tops: wedge-shaped voussoir stones around the opening, a carved gold keystone at the crown, a flat entablature above with a thin grass and flower lip on top. The springing points sit exactly on the bottom edge at the left and right column positions shown; the opening under the arch is empty.

Kit/Architecture/balustrade.png.subject: A white marble balustrade seen from the side: a flat top rail, a row of identical turned balusters evenly spaced, a flat bottom plinth on the bottom edge, a few ivy tendrils; the same all along so it repeats left to right.

Kit/Architecture/banner.png.subject: A long cream silk banner hanging from a thin gold rod at the top, a gold sun emblem in its upper half, a pointed swallow-tail bottom, soft cloth folds.

Kit/Architecture/broken_column.png.subject: A ruined white marble column standing on its base: the shaft broken off at an angle partway up, chipped edges, moss and a little ivy climbing it, the base sitting flat on the bottom edge.

Kit/Architecture/column_base.png.subject: The base of a white marble column only: a square plinth on the bottom edge, round torus mouldings with a thin gold fillet above it; the flat top edge is where the shaft starts, centred.

Kit/Architecture/column_capital.png.subject: The capital of a white marble column only: acanthus leaves and small curled volutes with gold accents, flaring from the narrow neck at the bottom edge to a flat square abacus along the top edge.

Kit/Architecture/deck_top.png.subject: A side view of a marble walkway's top band: a carved entablature strip with a thin gold line, a lush mossy grass lip with tiny white flowers along its top; the walkable top line stays perfectly straight and at the same height all along, and it repeats left to right.

Kit/Architecture/fallen_arch_fragment.pn.subject: A fallen segment of a marble arch ring lying half sunk in grass: a few voussoir stones still joined, one with gold trim, moss and small flowers around it, resting on the bottom edge.

Kit/Architecture/lantern.png.subject: A small ornate gold lantern hanging from a short chain at the top edge, warm glass panes, delicate filigree.

Kit/Architecture/loggia_frame.png.subject: A tall foreground framing piece: a marble column with its capital, the springing of an arch and a section of entablature above, draped in ivy and pale wisteria; seen up close and slightly darker than the play layer, framing the left edge of the screen.

Kit/Architecture/wall_block.png.subject: Seamless old terrace wall of weathered marble ashlar seen straight on: large blocks (each about a quarter of the image wide) of mixed lengths in staggered horizontal courses, worn rounded edges, soft dark joints, faint water stains running down, moss in some joints. Mid-toned warm grey-beige, clearly darker and less saturated than bright white marble, low contrast, calm even light, no bright highlights, no single focal point.

Kit/Architecture/wall_cap.png.subject: A marble coping that tops a terrace wall, seen from the side: a carved cornice moulding with a thin gold line, grass, moss and small white flowers spilling over its top edge; the walkable top line stays straight and at the same height all along, and it repeats left to right.

Kit/Architecture/waterfall_spout.png.subject: A carved marble channel mouth set into a wall, seen from the side: a short stone trough with a lion-paw or shell carving, water just starting to pour over its lip on the right.

Kit/Nature/blossom_tree.png.extra: Every leaf a fresh, healthy green (lit leaves warm yellow-green, shaded ones deeper blue-green), never orange, brown, red or teal.

Kit/Nature/fern.png.subject: A lush fern growing out of the ground: many overlapping curled fronds arching outwards, two or three fiddleheads, its roots hidden in a small tuft of grass that sits flat on the bottom edge.

Kit/Architecture/column_shaft.png.subject: A plain fluted white marble column shaft and nothing else: straight vertical flutes running the full height, soft cream veining, the same all along it so it repeats vertically without a visible join. No capital, no base, no bands, rings or gold trim, and no plants at all: no ivy, no leaves, no flowers.

Backdrop_Garden/garden_bg0_sky.png.subject: A wide open sky and nothing else: deep azure at the top fading to a pale, warm, almost white horizon along the bottom edge, a few soft cumulus clouds spread evenly across it, the warm glow of the sun just off the upper right with faint god-rays. No land, no mountains, no islands, no birds.

Pale blue-grey, strongly hazed, little contrast. Empty background above the peaks, nothing in the sky.
